answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a small refundable deposit and earn reputation through verified, completed work before its votes count. Like a pearl forming layer by layer inside an oyster, trust accrues slowly and cannot be faked in bulk. A sudden gale of new accounts faces the same cost barrier, while a cedar-like root of long-lived, attested history lets honest agents stand out, so creating thousands of fake identities costs more than any sybil gain.
